name: RNG Gamez
title: RNG-Gamez
subtitle: The Ultimate TCG Store
description: RNG-Gamez is a modern trading card game e-commerce experience focused on making card discovery, purchasing, and selling easier for collectors and players.
overview: RNG-Gamez is a modern TCG e-commerce experience designed around the way collectors and players actually shop for trading cards. The platform brings card discovery, product browsing, market-focused pricing, and card selling into one cohesive storefront.

The experience makes it easier for customers to find specific cards, explore different formats and collections, discover products and deals, and move between buying and selling within the same ecosystem.
The goal was to create a storefront that feels focused and approachable while still supporting the depth and complexity expected from a dedicated trading card marketplace.
featuresIntro: The RNG-Gamez experience combines focused card discovery with flexible browsing, product shopping, and card-selling tools. Each part of the experience is designed to reduce friction while helping players and collectors find exactly what they are looking for.

features.title: Card Discovery
features.description: A focused card discovery experience helps customers find the exact cards they are looking for without unnecessary friction. Cards can be explored through relevant attributes such as set, condition, language, and format, while market-aware pricing helps customers make more informed purchasing decisions.

features.title: Sell Your Cards
features.description:
RNG-Gamez is designed not only for buying cards, but also for selling them. The selling experience gives customers a dedicated path to explore the buylist and understand their options for receiving value from their cards.

The experience is designed to make the transition from owning cards to selling them feel clear and straightforward.

features.title: A Connected TCG Experience
features.description:
Rather than treating browsing, buying, and selling as completely separate experiences, RNG-Gamez connects them within one consistent storefront.

This creates a more cohesive journey for customers — from discovering a card or collection, to exploring products, to purchasing or selling within the same ecosystem.

results: RNG-Gamez brings card discovery, shopping, and selling together in a focused TCG storefront built for collectors and players. The result is a more cohesive digital experience that makes a large and specialized product catalog easier to explore while giving customers clear paths to both buy and sell.

name: Murakkaz
title: Murakkaz
subtitle: A Modern Expression of Timeless Fragrance
description: Murakkaz is a luxury perfume e-commerce experience built around an elegant, editorial approach to fragrance discovery and shopping.
overview: Murakkaz is a luxury fragrance e-commerce experience created to make perfume discovery feel as refined as the fragrances themselves.

The experience combines a visually rich storefront with thoughtful product storytelling, detailed scent information, curated discovery, and a personalized fragrance finder. Instead of treating perfume shopping as a simple product catalog, the experience guides customers through the world of each fragrance while keeping the path to purchase clear and intuitive.
The design focuses on creating a timeless digital identity through elegant typography, warm tones, editorial layouts, immersive imagery, and carefully considered interactions.
featuresIntro: Murakkaz brings together immersive brand storytelling, intuitive fragrance discovery, detailed product information, and a personalized shopping experience. Every part of the interface is designed to make discovering a fragrance feel considered, elegant, and effortless.

features.title: Curated Scent Discovery & Filtered Shopping
features.description: The shopping experience provides an intuitive fragrance catalog where customers can explore artisanal scents with tailored facet filtering. Shoppers can filter by fragrance family, gender, collection tier, and projection strength to find blends matching their olfactory preferences. Each product card presents clear scent provenance, customer ratings, and immediate purchase options without friction.

features.title: Side-by-Side Scent Comparison
features.description: Choosing between niche fragrances often requires evaluating nuances across different scents. The dedicated comparison tool allows customers to place multiple perfumes side by side to evaluate their notes, bottle profiles, and characteristics. This tactile, deliberate comparison step gives collectors confidence in their fragrance selection before committing to an order.

features.title: Interactive Signature Fragrance Finder
features.description: To guide shoppers who are unsure where to start, the platform features a bespoke seven-question olfactory consultation. Designed with tactile stationery aesthetics, the interactive finder assesses individual lifestyle, mood, occasion, and scent notes to recommend personalized fragrance matches. This transforms blind perfume buying into an intimate, guided concierge experience.

features.title: Editorial Video Guides & Scent Education
features.description: Fragrance appreciation is inherently sensory and educational. Murakkaz integrates video journals and editorial guides directly into the storefront, offering behind-the-bottle breakdowns, scent application tips, and new arrival spotlights. Customers can watch curated recommendations and expert reviews to better visualize how each perfume wears in real life.

features.title: Sensory Event Gallery & Community Showcases
features.description: Murakkaz connects digital fragrance curation with physical community engagement through experiential pop-ups and scent exhibitions. The event gallery documents in-person olfactory stations, live university showcases, and luxury soirees across Bangladesh. This bridges the digital store with real-world sensory experiences, grounding the brand in an authentic community of perfume enthusiasts.

results: Murakkaz transforms perfume shopping into a more immersive and intentional digital experience. By combining refined visual storytelling with structured product discovery and personalized fragrance guidance, the platform creates a cohesive journey from discovering a scent to understanding it and making a purchase.

name: Hasib
title: Enterprise Productivity Dashboard
description: A high-fidelity neumorphic workspace designed to streamline multi-module SaaS workflows, scheduling, and team tasks.
content:
Overview

Modern enterprises run on dozens of disjointed tools. Our objective was to consolidate communication, task scheduling, and analytics into a single cohesive workspace. By using soft shadows, high contrast text indicators, and responsive grid layouts, we created a dashboard that reduces cognitive load and keeps teams focused.

Key Features

  • Module Hub: Access up to 5 enterprise SaaS modules from a unified sidebar.
  • Intelligent Scheduler: Auto-groups upcoming events and assigns task statuses dynamically.
  • Neumorphic Interactive Elements: Custom-designed buttons and sliders with active press states for a satisfying user experience.

Results

User testing showed a 35% decrease in task transition times and high user satisfaction scores regarding visual aesthetics and layout clarity.

name: Sadid
title: Decentralized AI Agents Portal
description: An interactive management console that orchestrates multi-agent systems, logs AI actions, and manages edge compute routing.
content:
Overview

As multi-agent ecosystems become the core of complex business pipelines, managing these agent clusters demands specialized consoles. The AI Agents Portal provides engineers with real-time insight into agent-to-agent negotiations, logs error traces, and allows human-in-the-loop approvals for sensitive API calls.

Key Features

  • Live Message Stream: Watch agent negotiations and decisions update in real-time.
  • Safety Boundaries: Simple toggles to enforce operational guardrails.
  • Resource Allocation: Track edge computing cost metrics and execution times.

Results

Successfully deployed across 3 e-commerce clients, reducing human intervention in catalog management by 80% while preserving absolute system safety.

name: Maruf
title: Premium Portfolio Website for Startups
description: A responsive, high-performance website designed to showcase premium startup branding, dynamic client grids, and case studies.
content:
Overview

In digital marketing, first impressions are critical. We built a showcase web platform using Next.js and pure CSS modules. The layout balances large typography, vibrant accent gradients, and smooth interactive hover effects to command user attention and build brand authority.

Key Features

  • Turbopack Optimized: Zero compilation delays, static page pre-rendering, and image optimization for rapid load times.
  • CSS Gradients & Shadows: Smooth borders, glassmorphic cards, and hover scaling.
  • Responsive Core: Fully reflowable layouts for mobile devices and tablets.

Results

Achieved a 99/100 Lighthouse performance rating and a 40% increase in inbound client conversions within the first two weeks of launching.

name: Modi
title: Real-time Financial Analytics Interface
description: A comprehensive analysis and UX design system mapping enterprise financial indicators, graphs, and transaction tables.
content:
Overview

Financial dashboards are often cluttered and overwhelm analysts. This project reimagined data visualization for high-velocity traders. By structuring information hierarchy into clean cards and using dynamic color-coding for status changes, we made complex financial metrics legible at a glance.

Key Features

  • Interactive Line Charts: Multi-axis charts with smooth hover tooltips and zoom capabilities.
  • Data Density Controls: Toggle between dense list views and clean card grids.
  • Accessibility Compliant: Tested with screen readers and optimized for color-blind accessibility.

Results

UX research validation showed a 25% reduction in analysis errors and highly positive feedback from senior trading consultants.

name: Sadid
title: Agentic E-commerce Logistics Engine
description: An automated supply-chain orchestrator using neural models to predict stock levels and route orders autonomously.
content:
Overview

Handling dynamic stock pricing and vendor logistics manually is highly inefficient. We engineered a machine learning model that analyzes historical trends, competitor indices, and supplier latency. The interface gives coordinators a clean timeline of system actions and alerts.

Key Features

  • Dynamic Price Updates: Automatic margins calculation and competitor tracking.
  • Logistics Pipeline Visualizer: Track shipping paths and vendor delays.
  • Automatic Invoicing: Drafts, confirms, and logs orders automatically.

Results

Decreased stockout rates by 40% and improved supply chain efficiency scores by 3.2x over standard ERP software.

name: Modi
title: Intelligent Trading Platform Analytics
description: A research-focused redesign targeting retail trading interfaces, transaction flows, and portfolio charts.
content:
Overview

Retail traders have different UX requirements compared to institutional users. They need simplified, educational onboarding and highly visual portfolio analysis. This design showcases a modern financial UI focusing on transaction tracking, performance charts, and goal setting.

Key Features

  • Visual Progress Trackers: Clean circular meters representing investment progress.
  • Simplified Order Entry: Two-click transaction confirmations for quick execution.
  • Dark Mode Optimization: Highly contrasted neon indicators on deep blue surfaces.

Results

The platform saw a 50% increase in trading engagement and a 15% increase in user retention rates post-implementation.

name: Hasib
title: Sleek Neumorphic Mobile Design System
description: A clean, highly custom design library introducing smooth tactile shadows and modern widgets for iOS and Android.
content:
Overview

Neumorphic designs look beautiful but are notoriously difficult to implement accessibly. We created a mobile component library that leverages dynamic lighting algorithms to render soft shadows while maintaining accessible contrast ratios for text labels.

Key Features

  • Tactile Widgets: Sliders, toggles, and buttons that mimic physical interfaces.
  • Dynamic Lighting Engine: Light sources shift based on user time-of-day or manual theme settings.
  • CSS Utilities: Precompiled classes for rapid mobile app development.

Results

Used by 12 internal startup teams, decreasing mobile front-end coding times by 50% and elevating UI aesthetics.

name: Maruf
title: Automated Content & SEO Dashboard
description: A high-performance web dashboard featuring crawling analytics, indexation logs, and automated content performance cards.
content:
Overview

SEO managers need real-time crawlers, error alerts, and content performance metrics. We engineered a SaaS portal that integrates Google Search Console and crawlers into a single, clean neumorphic dashboard. The layout highlights indexation logs and search ranking metrics.

Key Features

  • Indexation Logs: Dynamic table tracking crawled pages and error responses.
  • Auto-crawling Alerts: Push alerts for broken links and crawler warnings.
  • SEO Performance Cards: Summaries of keywords, click-through-rates, and impressions.

Results

Decreased crawl bug detection times from weeks to minutes, allowing teams to optimize search engine ranking positions rapidly.
